title: Customizations
description: Customizations moved from the Agents window's modal into the docked right-hand side panel, using the product's real UI: the Customizations editor (Browse marketplace, Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks) opens as a tab next to Changes and Files in the docked editor part, at the product's default sizes (578px part, 150px section sidebar) — what VS Code Insiders renders with `workbench.editor.useModal: off`. Content is the live window's data with marketplace discovery on. Toggle the panel from the title bar (⌥⌘B), drag the sash to resize, switch sections, search, collapse groups and flip switches. Deep link a section with ?section=skills|mcp|plugins|instructions|agents|hooks.
